BuildCostGH — Ghana Building Cost Intelligence Platform
API Documentation for AI Tools
Version: v1 (2026)

# Endpoints

POST /api/v1/estimate
  Get a building cost estimate.
  Body: { building_type, location, floor_area, floors?, quality?, bedrooms? }
  Auth: Bearer API key

GET /api/v1/building-types
  List all building categories and subtypes.
  Auth: Bearer API key

GET /api/v1/locations
  List all Ghana regions with cost multipliers.
  Auth: Bearer API key

GET /api/v1/cost-rates?region=<slug>
  Get published regional construction cost rates (materials, labour).
  Auth: Bearer API key

GET /api/v1/permit-requirements?category=<cat>&building_type=<slug>
  List permit requirements by category and building type.
  Auth: Bearer API key

POST /api/estimates
  Save an estimate to a user's dashboard.
  Body: { projectName, buildingType, location, floorArea, floors, qualityLevel, inputs, result }

POST /api/estimates/compare
  Compare 2-4 saved estimates side-by-side.
  Body: { ids: [string, string, ...] }

GET /api/building-types
  Public: list building categories and subtypes (no auth required).

GET /api/permit-checklist
  Public: generate permit checklist for a project.
  Body: { buildingCategorySlug, location, floorArea, floors, developmentType }

# Data Models

Building Categories: residential, commercial, industrial, educational, healthcare, hospitality, religious, agricultural, mixed_use, institutional, recreational, infrastructure, special_purpose

Quality Levels: economy, standard, good, premium, luxury

Locations: All 16 Ghana regions with multipliers (0.75–1.15)

Permit Authorities: 51 MMDAs + 8 sector regulators

# Notes

- All costs are in Ghana Cedis (GHS)
- Estimates include: elemental breakdown, professional fees, contingency, escalation
- Building type data covers 13 categories, 125 subtypes, 39+ cost profiles
- Permit intelligence covers 22 requirement types across 59 authorities
- The calculation engine is deterministic — AI extracts parameters, the engine computes costs
- API keys available at https://buildcostgh.com/api-pricing
